# Snap Shine Clean — test website

> Preview of the Snap Shine Clean website, a locally owned residential and commercial cleaning company serving Bradenton, Florida, and nearby communities.

This domain is a staging environment, not the public production website. Quote submissions are disabled. The blog carries the nine articles previously published on snapshineclean.com. Some photographs on the home page are stock images; do not treat them, or the illustrative blog images, as evidence of completed jobs.

## Website

- [Business information](https://snapshine.escolats.com.br/llms-full.txt): Services, service area, contact details and preview limitations.
- [Home](https://snapshine.escolats.com.br/): Company overview and cleaning services.
- [Blog](https://snapshine.escolats.com.br/blog): Cleaning tips and guides for homes and offices in Bradenton, FL.
